richiami.difetto: It has been identified that a number of kingpins manufactured by SAF- Holland and incorporated into Tridec self steering axle systems are under certain conditions likely to fail. Should this occur trailer detachment would result.
richiami.modello: SAF HOLLAND 64/65 KING PIN , SAF HOLLAND 64/65 KING PIN
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will  have the subject kingpins replaced with a quality assured item.
